author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** New polaris-backend/src/api/auth_atproto.rs with two handlers: POST /auth/atproto/login (LoginRequest { handle }, calls AtprotoOauthAuthVerifier::start_login with LoginHint::AtprotoHandle, returns 303 with Location header) and GET /auth/atproto/callback (state+code from query, calls complete_login, mints Polaris session cookie via SessionStore::create, 303 to /). Mirror api/auth_oidc.rs pattern if it exists. Add /auth/atproto/* to middleware-exempt paths. Tests: 303 redirect on login, session cookie set on successful callback, 400 on missing query params.
